Dann sollten wir sprechen. Für unseren Auftraggeber, ein wachsendes schwedisches Industrieunternehmen mit international stark gefragten Produkten, suchen wir einen Market Manager DACH mit Verantwortung für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz. Ein etabliertes Unternehmen. Die nächste Wachstumsphase. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und produziert seit rund 20 Jahren eigene Produkte. Patentgeschützte Lösungen und vielfältige Einsatzmöglichkeiten bilden die Grundlage für eine starke internationale Nachfrage. Mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden und einer sehr soliden finanziellen Basis befindet sich das Unternehmen in einer dynamischen Phase der Skalierung und internationalen Expansion. Hauptsitz und Produktion liegen in Südschweden. Das Unternehmen ist in mehreren europäischen Ländern und auf weiteren internationalen Märkten präsent. Zu den Kunden und Geschäftspartnern gehören Händler, Distributoren und OEMs aus der Fertigungsindustrie, der Bauwirtschaft und der Fahrzeugindustrie. Der Vertrieb erfolgt je nach Markt direkt oder über ausgewählte Partner. Die Zuständigkeiten sind klar: Wo Vertriebspartner den Markt betreuen, gibt es keinen konkurrierenden Direktvertrieb des Unternehmens. Im Mittelpunkt stehen langfristige Partnerschaften und gemeinsames Wachstum. Du erkennst Potenzial. Und machst Geschäft daraus. Du entwickelst den DACH Markt, gewinnst neue Partners und baust ein leistungsfähiges Netzwerk aus Vertriebspartnern, Distributoren und Händlern auf. review_candidates.description: About Crunchyroll Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! About The Role As the Manager, Campaign Operations, UCANZ, you will be the regional campaign operations leader responsible for planning, orchestrating, and executing Crunchyroll’s integrated marketing campaigns across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. You will sit at the center of campaign strategy, creative development, project management, and channel execution. You will translate UCANZ marketing priorities into clear campaign plans, briefs, workback schedules, asset requirements, and launch plans, ensuring campaigns are scoped, localized, approved, and delivered on time and on budget. You will serve as a key campaign operations partner to UCANZ Growth and Marketing leadership. You will work closely with Creative Services, Project Management, User Acquisition, Social, Influencer Marketing, Lifecycle, Editorial, Content, Curation & Programming, and the Global Centers of Excellence. Success requires exceptional organization, creative judgment, clear communication, and strong cross-functional leadership. You will navigate complex workflows, manage competing priorities, and translate regional needs into high-quality campaign execution for fans across UCANZ. In the role of Manager, Campaign Operations, UCANZ, you will report to the Senior Director, Brand & Community, UCANZ. We are considering applicants for the locations of Los Angeles or Dallas. Core Areas of Responsibility UCANZ CAMPAIGN PLANNING & INTEGRATED EXECUTION Partner with UCANZ teams (Growth, Partnerships, Community, Membership Value, PR, etc) and Partner Relations & Content Marketing teams to translate campaign priorities into integrated plans and actionable workstreams. Develop and manage workback schedules, milestone calendars, dependencies, review cycles, and launch readiness plans across multiple concurrent campaigns. Ensure campaign briefs are complete, cohesive, and aligned to objectives, audiences, title priorities, channels, markets, and deliverables. Coordinate regional and global stakeholders to maintain clarity, accountability, and momentum from kickoff through launch. Anticipate risks, surface decisions, and proactively remove blockers that could affect quality, timing, or budget. CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT & ASSET OPERATIONS Partner with Creative Services and Project Management to define campaign asset suites across video, static, copy, social, digital, experiential, and other relevant formats. Serve as a strategic and operational resource to Title Marketing and Brand Management during campaign development. Consolidate feedback and coordinate internal, external, brand, creative, and licensor reviews to keep communication clear and efficient. Ensure assets align with the campaign strategy, regional requirements, brand standards, platform specifications, and delivery timelines. Support asset tracking, version control, production status, and final delivery across the campaign lifecycle. REGIONALIZATION & VERSIONING Translate regional insights and market needs into clear creative requests and execution plans for global and regional teams. Coordinate approvals and ensure localized assets are accurate, culturally relevant, brand-compliant, and delivered in the required formats. Identify opportunities to streamline regionalization, reduce duplication, and create scalable approaches to campaign adaptation. CHANNEL & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ORCHESTRATION Partner with User Acquisition, SVOD Marketing, Social, Influencer Marketing, Lifecycle, Editorial, and other channel teams to ensure cohesive full-funnel campaign execution. Align campaign plans with content, product, partnership, promotional, and UCANZ region marketing launches. Coordinate inputs from Content, Curation & Programming, Product, Analytics, Marketing Operations, and other stakeholders as needed. Maintain visibility into channel requirements, dependencies, open decisions, and launch readiness across the UCANZ campaign portfolio. Facilitate weekly campaign check-ins and provide concise updates, action items, and escalation points to regional and global teams. OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT Establish and maintain campaign documentation, trackers, status reporting, creative briefs, asset inventories, and shared sources of truth. Partner with Marketing Operations to improve workflows, tools, intake processes, review structures, and campaign governance. Identify process gaps and implement practical improvements that increase speed, visibility, quality, and cross-functional collaboration. Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and resource planning to ensure campaign execution remains aligned with approved plans. Develop reusable playbooks, templates, and best practices for UCANZ campaign planning and execution. PERFORMANCE, REPORTING & LEARNING Track campaign milestones, deliverables, launch readiness, risks, and post-launch follow-up across the regional portfolio. Partner with Analytics and channel teams to organize performance reporting, campaign learnings, and recommendations. Support post-campaign reviews that identify opportunities to improve process, creative effectiveness, localization, and channel execution. Provide clear, executive-ready updates on progress, issues, decisions, and outcomes. Mentor project partners and contribute to a collaborative, high-ownership, and solutions-oriented team culture. Delegate effectively when appropriate while remaining willing to step into detailed execution when needed. Share knowledge, tools, and best practices across UCANZ, Marketing Operations, Creative Services, and global teams. About You We get excited about candidates, like you, because... 5+ years of experience in global campaign operations, integrated marketing, creative production, project management, or brand & title marketing within entertainment, streaming, theatrical, or media industries. Demonstrated experience managing complex global campaigns from strategy and briefing through creative development, approvals, and launch. Experience executing campaigns across multiple markets, channels, and time zones, with a strong understanding of international mastering, versioning, and distribution. Experience working with the creative process across video, static, copy, social, digital, and experiential assets. Strong project management skills, including workback schedules, milestone tracking, dependencies, risk management, and cross-functional communication. Experience partnering with Title Marketing, Brand Management, Creative Services, and channel teams such as User Acquisition, Social, Influencer Marketing, and Lifecycle. Proven ability to consolidate feedback, manage ambiguity, prioritize competing needs, and drive accountability without direct authority. Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with distributed teams across multiple cultures and time zones. Strong organizational, written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Experience with Airtable, Wrike, Asana, Figma, or equivalent creative workflow and project management tools. PMP certification or equivalent project management experience is a plus. Passion for anime, entertainment, streaming, gaming, or fandom-driven brands is highly preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. About The Team The UCANZ Brand & Community team brings together regional marketing leaders and cross-functional partners to turn Crunchyroll’s biggest priorities into integrated, fan-first campaigns across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Working at the intersection of creative, content, growth, and channel teams, the group drives clear, culturally relevant launches that deepen fandom and deliver meaningful business impact. Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self. Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance Health Saving Account HSA program Health care and dependent care FSA 401(k) plan, with employer match Employer paid commuter benefit Support program for new parents Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly! review_candidates.description: Descriptif du poste Nous renforçons aujourd’hui notre pôle EPM avec le recrutement d’un(e) Manager / Chef de projet EPM sur l'une de nos technologies partenaires (Tagetik, Pigment,...), afin de piloter des projets stratégiques et accompagner la croissance de notre practice dédiée. Qui sommes nous ? MeltOne Advisory, c’est 200 consultants passionnés , plus de 10 ans d’aventure, et une mission claire : accélérer la transformation digitale de nos clients avec excellence opérationnelle, agilité et proximité. MeltOne est un cabinet de conseil indépendant en forte croissance. Avec 5 bureaux dans le monde (Paris, New-York, Montréal, Singapour & Bogota), on accompagne nos clients au plus près de leurs enjeux de digitalisation des processus. Notre modèle ? Le meilleur des deux mondes : 👉 L’esprit French Tech : innovation, agilité, esprit d’équipe, partenariat avec les éditeurs à la pointe de la technologie 👉 La solidité d’un grand cabinet : méthode, engagement sur le résultat, variété des expertises. Nous accompagnons des grands comptes du CAC 40 (luxe, retail, banque, industrie, énergie…) mais aussi les acteurs de la FrenchTech sur des projets complexes mêlant systèmes d’information, pilotage de la performance, et data . Ce qui nous anime ? Le goût du travail bien fait, l’esprit d’équipe, et l’envie de faire grandir nos clients comme nos collaborateurs. 🌈 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez MeltOne, Vous Trouverez 💰 Une rémunération attractive et de nombreux avantages (subventions CE, congés supplémentaires, cours de sport toutes les semaines...). 🏡 Une politique de télétravail 100 % libre afin de vous offrir un cadre de travail respectueux de votre équilibre vie professionnelle et personnelle. 📚 Un accompagnement personnalisé et des formations tout au long de votre vie de Meltoner afin que vous puissiez évoluer sur les plans professionnel et personnel. 🎉 Une ambiance propice à la créativité et à l’esprit d’équipe (ateliers internes, petits-déjeuners innovation, projets transverses...). 🤝 La possibilité de vous impliquer dans les projets RSE de votre choix : collecte de vêtements et de livres, don du sang, courses solidaires et même mécénat pour l’association de votre choix… Descriptif du poste En Tant Que Manager / Chef De Projet EPM Vous Interviendrez Sur Des Projets De Transformation Digitale Finance (et / Ou Consolidation), De La Phase De Cadrage à La Mise En Œuvre De La Solution. À Ce Titre, Vous Serez Amené À Piloter des projets d’implémentation Encadrer les consultants et assurer la montée en compétences des équipes projet Être l’interlocuteur de référence du client : pilotage, chiffrage, coordination, reporting, Accompagnement au changement Contribuer à la capitalisation interne (retours d’expérience, bonnes pratiques, documentation) Participer activement au développement commercial (avant-vente, réponses à appels d’offres, détection d’opportunités) Intervenir sur des projets en interne (formation, recrutement, ...) Être force de proposition sur les évolutions de notre offre EPM et la veille sur les solutions du marché Ce que l'on recherche Expérience confirmée au moins 3 ans en pilotage de projets EPM, idéalement avec une expertise sur Pigment ou Tagetik ou autre solution équivalente Bonne connaissance métier sur les sujets FP&A, et/ou consolidation (normes IFRS...) Appétence pour un environnement entrepreneurial, stimulant et en pleine croissance Anglais professionnel requis Ce poste est ouvert à toutes les candidatures, sans distinction, y compris aux personnes en situation de handicap. Déroulement des entretiens Entretien RH (30 min en visio) avec Sarah, Alisson ou Victor : Découverte mutuelle : on vous présente MeltOne et on vous laisse nous présenter votre parcours et vos ambitions. Entretien opérationnel (1h) avec un consultant senior ou manager : retour d’expérience, technique et projection dans notre contexte. Entretien final (1h en présentiel) avec un manager : cultural fit, réponses à vos questions ✅ Si tout match des deux côtés : on vous prépare un parcours d’intégration sur-mesure pour vous accompagner dans votre prise de poste chez MeltOne.
